title: arenaria verna var. japonica
intro: Arenaria verna var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese sandwort, is a plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and stomach cramps, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which help in soothing irritated tissues and fighting off infections. Arenaria verna var. japonica contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
